Because of a restructuring of the calendar of the season, this season contained three tournaments to bring the season to a fall-spring season (similar to the majority of leagues in Europe). The season began on January 15, 2010, and was scheduled to end in May 2011. "Final de la LPF rompió record", ''[[Mi Diario]]'', Panama, 18 May 2010. |lowest attendance = |average attendance = |prevseason = |nextseason = }} The '''2010 Clausura''' was the first tournament of the season. It began on January 25, 2010, and ended on May 14, 2010. The [[Club Deportivo Árabe Unido|Árabe Unido]] were crowned the champion after defeating [[San Francisco F.C.|San Francisco]] 1–0 in the first professional [[football (soccer)|football]] match played in the newly-remodeled [[Estadio Rommel Fernández]]. This was Arabe's 2nd title in a row and sixth in its history. After clinching this win, the [[Club Deportivo Árabe Unido|Árabe Unido]] earned the Panama 1 spot in the [[2010–11 CONCACAF Champions League]] and [[Tauro F.C.|Tauro]] the Panama 2 spot as the runner-up with the most points in the [[Liga Panameña de Fútbol Apertura 2009 II|2009 Apertura II]] and 2010 Clausura season.{{Cite web |url=http://www.fepafut.com/noticiasdetail.asp?id=1827 |title=Árabe Unido, campeón del torneo Clausura LPF 2010 |access-date=2010-05-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110710235108/http://www.fepafut.com/noticiasdetail.asp?id=1827 |archive-date=2011-07-10 |url-status=dead }} [[San Francisco F.C.|San Francisco]] obtained the Panama 3 spot after the [[Belize Premier Football League]] champion failed to meet the [[CONCACAF]] stadium requirements, thus the vacated spot was awarded to Panama's runner-up with less points.{{Cite web |url=http://www.concacaf.com/page/CL/NewsDetail/0,,12813~2055236,00.html |title=Motagua, San Francisco get CCL berths |access-date=2010-05-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110610223334/http://www.concacaf.com/page/CL/NewsDetail/0,,12813~2055236,00.html |archive-date=2011-06-10 |url-status=dead }} ===First round=== ====Standings==== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=Q |team1=CHI|name_CHI=[[Atlético Chiriquí]] |team2=DÁU|name_DÁU=[[Club Deportivo Árabe Unido|Árabe Unido]] |team3=CHO|name_CHO=[[Chorrillo F.C.|Chorrillo]] |team4=SF|name_SF=[[San Francisco F.C.|San Francisco]] |team5=ALI|name_ALI=[[Alianza F.C.
